title: A fallback first load right after a connect: the mark stays, and the cloud's first open adopts whatever erase the record is at then, so drafts typed before an erase made in between stay (also a switch away and back across an erase)
evidence: Lead A11, 2026-11-12. packages/health-core/src/record-host.ts clearedAtOpen (ADOPT_ERASE, fallback), keepCleared; widget-src/standalone/connect.ts adoptNextErase. Pinned by record-session.clear-owed.test.ts (the fallback test; case 5: the mark and a key set to the lifted record's identity both clear 0 times, a removed key clears once) and web-record-host.cleared-erase.test.ts. Smallest fix not built: a switch-away clears the off-file data it leaves behind
